name: github_pr_diff
display_name: GitHub PR Code Review Diff Tool (TypeScript)
description: Fetch diff files and patch details for any GitHub pull request to enable automated AI code reviews. Also retrieves review comments.

action.description: Action to perform: 'diff' to fetch changed files and patches, 'comments' to fetch review comments

include_patch.description: Include the unified diff patch content for each file (default true)
